title: Los Angeles RSO annual allowable rent increase
requirement: For rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, the annual allowable rent increase is 3% for July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026. From February 2, 2026 no additional percentage increase for utilities may be added.
coverage_conditions: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (L.A.M.C. §151.00 et seq.)
quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%.
